title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Solid Brass | 8 Pivoting Pegs | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Coat Rack With Eight Pivoting Pegs 60-Inch
description:
Stop piling coats and towels on counters—create an organized drop zone without drilling into walls. This freestanding coat rack with eight pivoting pegs keeps items separated and easy to reach, making it a smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Keep everyday items organized: eight pivoting pegs let you hang coats, hats, and accessories with less crowding
- Place it anywhere: freestanding design requires no wall mounting for flexible layout changes
- Stay steady on the floor: weighted base is designed to keep the rack stable to prevent tipping
- Protect finished floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Coordinate your space: designed to pair with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 26 x 26 x 12 in.
- Shipping weight: 18 lbs.
- Material: solid brass construction
- Assembly: some assembly required
